name: gifsaver
onCreateCommand: curl -fsSL https://dl.yarnpkg.com/debian/pubkey.gpg | sudo gpg --dearmor --batch --yes -o /usr/share/keyrings/yarn-archive-keyring.gpg && sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends libx11-dev libgif-dev libasound2-dev xvfb x11-utils && sudo rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
